target.objective: area mean ambient minus air temperature > 6 C

assumptions: Prescribed 8 mm source flow into an explicit internal diffuser
Constant density, dry air, passive temperature deficit
Axisymmetric still-air jet; wind and buoyancy excluded
No source backpressure response, wall warming, moisture or skin model

diffuser.wall_temperature_model: Adiabatic; heat pickup must be checked separately

warmstart_repair: Only copy fields written by the active turbulence model. SST does not write epsilon.
